tagline: Dorms, private rooms, free Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception and guest discounts at Sláinte Irish Pub.
blurb: Whether you are travelling solo, with friends or as a group, White Tulip Hostel offers affordable accommodation in central Amsterdam.

story.title: Why stay at White Tulip Hostel?
paragraphs:
Central location in Amsterdam city centre
5-minute walk from Amsterdam Central Station and Dam Square
Dorms and private rooms for budget travellers
Free Wi-Fi throughout the hostel
24-hour reception and helpful staff
Guest discounts at Sláinte Irish Pub
Ideal for backpackers, solo travellers, groups and weekend trips
Looking for a budget hostel in Amsterdam city centre? White Tulip Hostel is a practical base for dorms, private rooms, nightlife, sightseeing and direct booking.

rooms.name: Dorm Rooms
rooms.blurb: Our dorm rooms  are a practical choice for backpackers, solo travellers and friends who want to stay centrally and meet other travellers. Dorm beds help keep your trip affordable while placing you within walking distance of major sights, nightlife and transport links.

rooms.name: Mixed dormitory rooms
rooms.blurb: Mixed dormitory rooms are available in different sizes, including smaller dorm options such as 4-bed dorm rooms when available. These rooms are ideal if you want a social hostel atmosphere in Amsterdam city centre with easy access to the Red Light District and Central Station.

rooms.name: Private and double hostel rooms
rooms.blurb: Prefer more privacy? The White Tulip Hostel also offers private and double hostel room options, including standard double rooms when available. These rooms suit couples, friends or travellers who want a private base while still enjoying the location and atmosphere of a central Amsterdam hostel.  Guests can use free Wi-Fi throughout the hostel, and lockers are available for storing personal items. We recommend bringing your own padlock. Our reception team is available 24 hours a day to help with directions, local tips, check-in questions and practical information about your stay.  Staying at White Tulip Hostel also means you are close to Sláinte Irish Pub, located below the hostel. It is a convenient place to meet other travellers, enjoy food and drinks, or relax after a day of sightseeing. Learn more about The White Tulip Hostel or contact us before booking.
